title: Dome hoop in a hard beauty light

tokens.v: A beauty close-up in front of the painted canvas: she is turned three-quarters away, chin lifted, the crop running from her crown to her collarbone, the dome hoop on her near ear catching one hard specular from a bare dish high on the right. A faint sheen across her cheekbone and jaw, bare shoulders, no other jewellery. 85mm at f/4, focus on the hoop, her far eye just soft.
